sm120_linear_backend_marlin.symptom: With default linear_backend=auto the selected MXFP8 kernel may fall outside the QDQ plugin's marlin patch coverage; no QDQ operation trace (observed on 2026-10-19 QDQ RULER run pitfall #1).
sm120_linear_backend_marlin.fix: Pass linear_backend=marlin explicitly in eval model_args; smoke asserts `Using MarlinMxfp8LinearKernel for MXFP8 GEMM` and (with VLLM_QDQ_TRACE=1) a `backend=CuTe format=MXFP8 op=marlin_gemm` trace line.

qdq_env_var_unknown_warning.symptom: vLLM envs.py logs `Unknown vLLM environment variable detected: VLLM_QDQ[...]` at startup.
qdq_env_var_unknown_warning.root_cause: Plugin-owned variables are not part of core vLLM env schema.
qdq_env_var_unknown_warning.fix: Benign; verify success via `QDQ patches applied: ... torch.ops._C.marlin_gemm (MXFP4, MXFP8)` and `CUTE QDQ backend requested` lines instead.

q_scale_naming_note.symptom: Grep for `_k_scale/_v_scale/_q_scale` in the exported index finds nothing although static KV/attn scales are present.
q_scale_naming_note.root_cause: AutoRound 0.16.1 llm_compressor export names them as Parameter-style keys `...self_attn.k_scale` (no underscore prefix); vLLM creates Parameter with that exact name and registers *_scale buffers at load (compressed_tensors.py:1159-1269).
q_scale_naming_note.fix: Audit by suffix pattern `self_attn.(q|k|v)_scale` instead of `_q_scale`; engine boot log is the second source of truth.

aqa_local_unique_dir_and_dry_run.symptom: unique_dir field has no consumer in this checkout; `aqa run --dry-run` writes aqa_run.json=running into output.dir (corrupts an existing terminal run dir; AGENTS pitfall #9).
aqa_local_unique_dir_and_dry_run.fix: Use a literal fresh output dir for the real run and do dry-runs through a throwaway copy of the yaml pointing at /tmp paths.
